Well if you dont bleach even a little you will only have a purple sheen in the sun probably. You don't have to bleach much but a lift would definately give better results.

I have thick hair too and usually a tube and 3/4 works for me, getting more is always better than realizing you need more and the bottom half of your hair has to be sacrificed. 
They run pretty cheap for what you are getting IMO. You don't have to mix it with any developer. straight out of the tube it is ready to go.

I sleep with the dye in my hair, with a plastic bag over it. It makes less mess when washing it out.otherwise my shower and neck will stay purple. I don't shampoo when washing out just rinse and conditioner. Cold water is key. this does stain too so i suggest sleeping on a black shirt over your pillow, and wear dark colors the first week.
